open_points.subject: erase_project: [TEST_EVIDENCE]
open_points.text: - erase_project: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that after anonymising a project it has no revision and its card answers its anonymised form; that anonymising it again answers changed false and writes nothing; that correcting it or erasing it stating its former revision is refused with the STALE_REVISION member of = models.RefusalKind and changes nothing; and that after deleting it whole read_project_card answers the UNKNOWN_PROJECT member of = models.RefusalKind.
open_points.other_text: - ProjectCardReadOutcome discriminated union on field 'outcome' (exact variants, no others exist): ProjectCardFound (outcome='accepted'), Refusal (outcome='refused'); a value of ProjectCardReadOutcome is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and ProjectCardReadOutcome itself is not constructed
open_points.question: Must the test say that read_project_card answers a Refusal carrying a failure with the UNKNOWN_PROJECT member of = models.RefusalKind, or must ProjectCardReadOutcome be changed to admit RefusalKind directly?
